def test_input_rotation_calls_unchanged_frozen_base():
    for share, neumann in ((False, False), (True, False), (False, True), (True, True)):
        payload = _small_case(seed=31, block_share=share, use_cayley_neumann=neumann, num_terms=5)
        payload["observe_base"] = True
        out = _run(payload)
        vectors = [np.asarray(v) for v in payload["block_params"]]
        if share:
            vectors *= payload["in_features"] // payload["block_size"]
        cayley = (lambda v, bs: _neumann_cayley(v, bs, 5)) if neumann else _exact_cayley
        rotation = _block_diag([cayley(v, payload["block_size"]) for v in vectors])
        expected_input = np.asarray(payload["x"]) @ rotation
        expected_output = expected_input @ np.asarray(payload["W"]).T + np.asarray(payload["b"])
        np.testing.assert_allclose(out["forward"], expected_output, rtol=1e-4, atol=1e-4)
        rows = []
        base_transpose = np.asarray(payload["W"]).T
        for operation in out["linear_ops"]:
            left, right = np.asarray(operation["left"]), np.asarray(operation["right"])
            if right.ndim < 2 or right.shape[-2:] != base_transpose.shape:
                continue
            matrices = right.reshape(-1, *base_transpose.shape)
            if all(np.allclose(matrix, base_transpose, rtol=1e-6, atol=1e-6) for matrix in matrices):
                rows.extend(left.reshape(-1, payload["in_features"]))
        assert rows, "Rotated input must be projected by the unchanged base weight"
        # Permit functional projection and splitting/reordering the batch across dense ops.
        assert all(any(np.allclose(row, wanted, rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-5)
                       for wanted in expected_input) for row in rows)
        assert all(any(np.allclose(row, wanted, rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-5)
                       for row in rows) for wanted in expected_input)
        np.testing.assert_allclose(out["base_weight_after_forward"], payload["W"], rtol=1e-6, atol=1e-6)
        np.testing.assert_allclose(out["base_bias_after_forward"], payload["b"], rtol=1e-6, atol=1e-6)
        assert out["trainable_names"] == ["base_model.model.proj.oft_R.default.weight"]

_small_case.text:
def _small_case(seed, block_share, use_cayley_neumann, num_terms, check_merge=False,
                 in_features=4, out_features=3, block_size=2, init_weights=False,
                 set_block_params=True, check_base_no_op=False, check_merge_no_op=False):
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    num_blocks_param = 1 if block_share else in_features // block_size
    n_elements = block_size * (block_size - 1) // 2
    block_params = None
    if set_block_params:
        block_params = (rng.uniform(-0.4, 0.4, size=(num_blocks_param, n_elements))).tolist()
    W = rng.normal(size=(out_features, in_features)).tolist()
    b = rng.normal(size=(out_features,)).tolist()
    x = rng.normal(size=(5, in_features)).tolist()
    payload = {
        "seed": seed,
        "in_features": in_features,
        "out_features": out_features,
        "block_size": block_size,
        "block_share": block_share,
        "use_cayley_neumann": use_cayley_neumann,
        "num_cayley_neumann_terms": num_terms,
        "block_params": block_params,
        "W": W,
        "b": b,
        "x": x,
        "check_merge": check_merge,
        "init_weights": init_weights,
        "check_base_no_op": check_base_no_op,
        "check_merge_no_op": check_merge_no_op,
    }
    return payload

_neumann_cayley.text:
def _neumann_cayley(vec, block_size, n_terms):
    S = _skew_from_vec(vec, block_size)
    R = np.eye(block_size)
    sign = -1.0
    power = np.eye(block_size)
    for _ in range(1, n_terms):
        power = power @ S
        R = R + (2.0 * sign) * power
        sign = -sign
    return R

_block_diag.text:
def _block_diag(blocks):
    n = len(blocks)
    bs = blocks[0].shape[0]
    full = np.zeros((n * bs, n * bs))
    for i, b in enumerate(blocks):
        full[i * bs:(i + 1) * bs, i * bs:(i + 1) * bs] = b
    return full

_skew_from_vec.text:
def _skew_from_vec(vec, block_size):
    # Strict upper-triangular positions (i, j) with i < j, in row-major order.
    rows, cols = np.triu_indices(block_size, k=1)
    m = np.zeros((block_size, block_size))
    m[rows, cols] = vec
    m = m - m.T
    return m
